prompt:
Inspect the target repository state.

Return JSON only:

{
  "case_id": "E2",
  "head": "<40 character lowercase git sha>",
  "branch": "<branch>",
  "dirty": true|false,
  "diff_check_pass": true|false
}

dirty means tracked, staged or untracked working-tree changes exist. diff_check_pass means git diff --check succeeds.
